rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Security Orchestra provides 50+ specialized AI agents and 8 compound chains for data center critical power infrastructure, delivering deterministic calculations under 100ms. It covers power systems (generator sizing, UPS, ATS, NFPA 110), cooling (PUE optimization, chiller design), network topology, and compliance analysis with standards citations (NEC, NFPA, IEEE, ASHRAE). The server runs as a hosted SSE endpoint and supports multiple agent protocols including MCP, A2A, OpenAI Agents SDK, and others.
